newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's downgrades Atlas Copco rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's downgrades Atlas Copco rating.

text.p: Credit ratings agency Moody's said on Thursday it had downgraded Swedish engineering group Atlas Copco AB's short term rating to Prime-2 from Prime-1 since the group's purchase of U.S. company Prime Services Inc.
"The rating downgrade reflects the expected marked deterioration of Atlas Copco's balance sheet following its acquisition of Prime Services Inc," Moody's said in a statement.
It said in its opinion, Prime Services "might need some further funding as it builds its position in the fast growing and consolidating equipment rentals business sector in the U.S.."

Moody's said the debt-financed purchase of Prime Services for around $900 million and $260 million in assumed debt was a logical move into an area which showed better growth than the company's core business.
The purchase -- Atlas Copco's largest to date -- would also allow the company to develop additional sales channels for its products, Moody's said.
But the price of Prime was high relative to its current profitability and Prime may need funds to boost its business, Moody's said.
Atlas Copco may not be able to reduce debt levels as swiftly and decisively as it has following previous acquisitions, it added.
